permission.outcomeExpired: Timed out. {source} was told it was cancelled
permission.outcomeDeliveryFailed: Could not send the decision. Please handle it in {source}
permission.outcomeConflict: This request can no longer be answered here. Please go back to {source}
permission.outcomeError: Something went wrong sending the decision. Try again, or handle it in {source}
permission.noticeTitleMulti: {count} agents are waiting for your approval
permission.noticeWhereApp: Go back to the {source} desktop app to handle it
permission.noticeExternalOnly: This agent's permission requests can only be answered in its original tool.
permission.noticeHelpLabel: Why can't I approve this here?
permission.noticeExplain: Codex only tells Agent Pets that it is waiting for permission and gives no way to send a decision back, so it cannot be approved here. OpenCode can be approved right from the pet bubble; Claude Code can once "Answer Claude Code permissions from the pet" is turned on in Settings.
permission.notifyExternal: {source} is waiting for approval (go back to its tool)
permission.settingsIntro: Which agents' permission requests can be handled right from the pet bubble:
permission.settingsReminderOnly: Reminder only; answer in the original tool
permission.settingsRiskRules: Risk is judged conservatively: only read-only tools such as read and search count as low risk; Claude Code edits to ordinary files inside the project folder (Write, Edit) count as medium, while edits outside it or to .git, .claude, shell start-up files and similar are high; commands, network access and any other tool count as high or unknown. Those requests cannot be approved with the global shortcut, and when their text is cut off they can only be denied here.
permission.hotkeyUnavailable: The shortcut is taken by another app; use the buttons instead
permission.keyboardHint: Keyboard: N or Esc denies; hold Y for 0.6 s to allow
permission.keyboardHintLow: Keyboard: N or Esc denies; Y allows once
permission.dndEndedBody: {count} notifications were silenced while it was on
permission.trayExternal: {count} to approve in the original tool
permission.trayPluginsOmitted: {count} more command(s) not shown; use the panel
permission.auditPrivacy: Only the time, tool name, source and result are recorded; commands and file paths are never stored.
permission.claudeRespond: Answer Claude Code permissions from the pet
permission.claudeRespondHelp: Claude Code permission requests appear in the bubble, where you can allow once or deny. The terminal prompt stays available too, and whichever answers first wins. If the pet is closed, the wait runs out or anything fails, Claude Code handles it as usual.
permission.claudeWaitHelp: After this the bubble is taken down; answer in the terminal instead. {min}–{max} seconds.
permission.alsoInTerminal: You can also answer in the terminal
permission.allowNeedsFullView: Too long to show in full. Check it in {source} to allow it.
